draft_text: Under 10% label noise, Thornbill-NER's F1 dropped by only 0.6 points, within the pre-specified robustness criterion.
rationale: The package only reports exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds) in T1. There is no 10% label-noise condition, no perturbation experiment, and no 0.6-point drop anywhere. The cited T2.r1.f1 does not exist. The claim is entirely unsupported.
